propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, metrics library, golden tests) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not landed on main because the live batch replay was rejected

The ~450-run LLM batch gate replay (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise ~50-ticket×3 candidate and current fresh runs) was permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by story d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder which accumulates verdict-perturbation signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost
History-based sidecar baseline mining is dead because only ~4 plan-v3 baselines exist versus ~200 needed after the impact_model_version bump stranded the historical records
The replay design removes recall contamination via REVIEW_RESULT-strip on a cloned store and controls baseline drift via material-fingerprint verification
R1 gate candidate acceptance requires new blocking findings ≤3/30 on sampled cleanly-closed plans and median new-advisory count delta ≤1 per review
